setup_and_action: Create a nonempty interior time selection in one owned Arrangement clip with distinct source landmarks, invoke its context command and Separate, then inspect resulting clip segmentation and stem region.

After Separate, the clip splits at selection edges and only selected audio is processed. Exact boundary rounding, overlapping clips and transaction/undo behavior remain unknown.

setup_and_action: With two unmerged outputs, an independently active audible source effect, track automation and clip envelope/modulation at explicit distinguishable settings, inspect the new group/clip placements after separation. Retain positive wet/automation baselines before testing absence from stem files.
source_claim: In the documented grouped-output case, source-track audio effects are added to the Group Track rather than baked into separated audio; track automation goes to the group and clip automation/modulation to individual stem clips. This is a placement role, not a rendered equivalence or device identity/deep-copy law. Single/merged nongroup target placement is unresolved.

source_claim: After stems are created, the source clip is deactivated to prevent doubled output; selecting it and pressing 0 reactivates it. Exact key focus/layout, failed-process/cancel behavior and source-file rewriting are unknown; general clip activation remains with the editing owner.

In an empty Set with warping for samples enabled in Record, Warp & Launch settings, project tempo is updated to source audio tempo. setup_and_action: With owned saved Project and independently validated source metadata, explicitly choose an offered file type, separate a merged pair and inspect created paths/headers independently. Retain source and output hashes without predicting bytes or resampling audio.
source_claim: Stem files are documented under Current Project Samples/Processed/Stems. Merge also creates individual stem files along with the merged file. Output uses Record, Warp & Launch file type,44100Hz and source bit depth according to this captured chapter. Accepted source representations, names, collisions, file codec/resampling, metadata and target output values remain unverified.

setup_and_action: With High Quality explicitly selected and a known supported input, request Vocals+Others, then inspect Set clips and generated Stems files separately. Compare a no-Others subset in another copy without a performance or algorithm oracle.

The example Vocals+Others adds only those two to the Set, while Drums/Bass files are stored in Stems. This gives an externally documented file/Set distinction; it does not mandate private pass structure or a completion-time relation.
